fitDiagnostic.use: Descriptive fit-only evidence; excluded from every quality/target decision.

mapping.sqlScope: games.fold='fit'; candidates>1; all fit index rows checked for bijection; kan opportunities use offered bit4

summary.scope: All original 8439 fit opportunities, 223 positives and 8216 natural negatives. Fixed four mix endpoints.
limitations: Fit-only descriptive diagnosis; no generalization or full-quality acceptance claim.
No seed, checkpoint, model or bias is selected from these curves.
Seen/unseen strata use the frozen sampler replay and report zero-bias outcomes only. Cumulative loss coefficients are before division by batch size, not gradient contributions.
Curves cover all/old/new/each true action; per-window CSV retains complete game identities.

Float32 model logits are converted to float64; margin=max legal kan minus max legal non-kan. Both within-group maxima retain the first original candidate index. Equality at bias=-margin uses the smaller original index. This is a real additive score-bias counterfactual, not verification of a float32 parameter edit.

bootstrap.method: Whole games with replacement within old/new holdout strata; fixed stratum sizes; shared draws across all four models; ratios of summed counts.
bootstrap.interval: Two-sided 95% percentile; pointwise, not simultaneous across actions or random seeds.

limitations: All four step5000 endpoints and both paired seeds retained; no bias/checkpoint/seed selection.
Full quality requires both unchanged screen_pair comparisons and all original support checks.
Architecture thresholds are historical context, not a new sampler success rule or a retrospective pass.
Strict >75 user point estimates are separate from the original preservation guard at >=75.
FitMonitor is diagnostic only, not full fit support or an independent holdout.
Model identity is checked from bound evaluator/report descriptors without opening model bytes.
Internal three-player holdout does not certify formal validation/test performance or four-player actions.
